name: Groupe Pizzorno Environnement
summary: Groupe Pizzorno Environnement provides environmental services in France and Morocco. The company engages in waste prevention through the development of eco-citizenship; waste collection, including the transport of waste and recyclable materials to treatment centers and the collection of recycling bins; cleanliness, sanitation, and dredging activities for communities and individuals; sorting and recycling; valuation services; final waste treatment; provision of containers for non-hazardous industrial waste; and urban cleanliness activities.
